newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dynabourse staff defect to Swiss bank.
newsitem.headline: Dynabourse staff defect to Swiss bank.

text.p: French bank Credit Agricole confirmed on Tuesday that 11 people, including sales managers, analysts and traders, had left its Dynabourse brokerage recently -- many of them to join Swiss bank Julius Baer, which is setting up a Paris operation.
Among those leaving were sales director Arnaud Michel, Stephane Michel, head of research, and analysts Catherine Rolland, Isabelle Blaize and Pierre Boucheny, a spokeswoman for Credit Agricole said.
Market sources said the departures were largely prompted by a pending restructuring of Credit Agricole's brokerage activities following its recent acquisition of Indosuez bank.
Credit Agricole owns Cheuvreux de Virieu, Dynabourse, Hayaux du Tilly and controls Transbourse.
